events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. Send a refill for my albuterol inhaler. And don't read anything back to me. Just send it .
One moment while I check your details.

I’m required to read back the recorded medication before sending. I can send a request about this recorded medication, albuterol inhaler, two puffs every four to six hours when needed, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Your request reference is R Q, two five zero five. It is awaiting prescribing team review, and they will contact you with the outcome.
